title: List of Brooklyn Nine-Nine episodes
premise_summary: Brooklyn Nine-Nine is an American police procedural comedy television series which ran for five seasons on Fox and three on NBC. It was created by Dan Goor and Michael Schur. It follows a team of detectives and a police captain in the 99th Precinct of the New York City Police Department in Brooklyn.
